ActorTalk: How are you still wandering around here? Aren't you supposed to be heading out to handle some paperwork?
...You seriously can't sit still, can you? Just try not to wander off and stumble into another mess.
I've got things to handle. No more small talk.
Command just dumped a pile of miscellaneous tasks on me. Guess I'll be "slumming it" here for a while.
Peacekeeping drills, system checks, guest lectures, and whatever other random crap they throw my way. Just need to plow through it all as fast as possible.
I do, but not now. I'll be stationed at F.O.S. for the foreseeable future anyway, so plenty of time to assign you work.
I want to look around more.
Then why are you still here, Vanessa?
